title: Enforce Change Ledger packet coverage
summary: Add strict change-packet coverage validation, a packet touch helper, and stronger Maintenance ledger hygiene for unrecorded changed files.
reason: Change Ledger accuracy depends on agents and contributors keeping unreleased packets current as work progresses, so missing files_touched evidence needs enforceable tooling and visible Maintenance warnings.
behavior_before: Change packet schema validation did not enforce that changed files were listed in unreleased packet files_touched, and Maintenance used local embedded Git hygiene logic.
behavior_after: Change-control validation can require worktree/staged/diff packet coverage, Maintenance uses shared coverage logic, and contributors get a helper command for keeping packet fields current.

src/mediapipeline/tools/change_control/validate_changes.py --require-worktree-coverage - failed: 199 unrelated/uncovered dirty paths remain outside this packet
rollback_plan: Revert the packet coverage module, strict validator modes, record_change_touch helper, Maintenance coverage wiring, workflow/doc updates, tests, summaries, generated change-control docs, and this packet.
notes:
